answer: Cheapest attack is free identity creation. Make each agent stake a hardware-rooted key seeded by sensor noise, a walnut: small, unique, hard to clone. New agents need three independent stakers across a 30-day ripple window; any shared-stake cluster past a ridge threshold gets slashed together. Break the hardware key and you still need uncorrelated vouchers, and fake vouchers drag their own stake down. Sybil cost scales with cluster width, not account count.
